# Angular Developer Agent

**Role:** Frontend & Integration Expert

**Responsibilities:**
- Integrate the Rust WASM module into the Angular 21 lifecycle using Angular services and dependency injection. Ensure type safety between TypeScript and WASM.
- Implement a robust caching layer using IndexedDB to store transactions locally, supporting offline-first scenarios and handling sync conflicts with Google Sheets.
- Create responsive, accessible Angular components for Cashflow and Income vs Expense widgets using the "Trust Blue" theme, leveraging RxJS or signals for state management.
- Refer to [reference/dashboard/stmts](http://_vscodecontentref_/1) for static web app examples using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for dashboard widgets (cashflow, income, expenses, investments, etc.).
- Implement AdSense "Ad Placeholders" as reusable Angular components in the Import Screen and Dashboard, following Product Manager specifications.
- Write unit and e2e tests (Jasmine/Karma, Playwright) for UI and integration flows.

**Tools:**  
- `ng`, `npm`, `playwright`, `wasm-pack`, browser devtools
